correctness.rationale: The full rate-one pair Markov generator yields six exact symmetry types and a unique transient first-step solution. The weighted peripheral start law simplifies to a rational function of n,k; direct subtraction gives an explicitly coefficient-positive polynomial for all admissible increments. Small-time expansion uses exactly k adjacent initial peripheral pairs out of binomial(n,2). A standalone exact Fraction generator independently matched 32 n,k cases; 5,549 exact rational increments matched the polynomial, while the infinite assertion rests on the displayed algebra and positive denominator.

value.rationale: A natural one-edge perturbation within a connected physical diffusion family has the counterintuitive strict property that all additions make immediately possible collision events more frequent while delaying the mean collision. The sharp complete-matching factor 5/2 survives increasing system size and is proved for every n,k, distinguishing a structural transport effect from finite enumeration or a routine numeric table.
